store.name: Phil's Apps
store.tagline: Accessibility tools, finance trackers, and small web experiments by Philip Brocoum.

apps.name: My Net Worth
apps.subtitle: All your stocks, ETFs, crypto wallets, 401(k), on one page
apps.description: See stocks, ETFs, crypto wallets, retirement accounts, and debt on one page with hourly price updates and no account connections.
apps.longDescription: My Net Worth was built to put Fidelity 401(k)s, Vanguard investments, E-Trade and IBKR stocks, bank accounts, and crypto wallets on one page. It is intentionally simple and safe: nothing connects directly to your accounts, and live prices refresh hourly so you can track your full portfolio across TradFi and DeFi in one place.
apps.requirements: Chrome on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, and Android.
features: Track traditional and crypto assets together on one page
Support Yahoo Finance symbols plus Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM wallets, and Solana wallets
Keep accounts disconnected while prices refresh hourly

apps.name: PhilNav
apps.subtitle: Infrared head mouse for hands-free computer control
apps.description: Control your computer hands-free with a reflective sticker and a Raspberry Pi-powered infrared head mouse running at 75 FPS.
apps.longDescription: PhilNav is a custom infrared head mouse that lets you move the cursor hands-free by tracking a reflective sticker on your head. The software is open source on GitHub, and this listing points to the assembled Gumroad hardware package built by Philip Brocoum for accessibility-focused computing.
apps.requirements: Raspberry Pi hardware on the server side plus a Windows, Mac, or Linux client machine.
features: Hands-free cursor movement using infrared head tracking
Runs at 75 FPS with low-latency mouse control
Cross-platform client support for Windows, macOS, and Linux

apps.name: Tater Talk
apps.subtitle: The simplest speech-to-text dictation web-app on Win/Mac/Nix
apps.description: The easiest way to talk to your computer on Win, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android, and the browser with optional bring-your-own premium speech models.
apps.longDescription: Tater Talk is a browser-based dictation app built to make talking to your computer feel simple across Windows, macOS, Linux, iPhone, Android, and the web. The current version adds a polished redesign and bring-your-own API key support for premium speech-to-text providers such as Microsoft Azure and AssemblyAI.
apps.requirements: Chrome on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, and Android.
features: Browser-based speech-to-text with no install
Works across Win, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android, and desktop browsers
Supports bring-your-own API keys for premium speech-to-text models

apps.name: Poker Tracker
apps.subtitle: Track your live poker PnL with a simple web app
apps.longDescription: Poker Tracker is a lightweight web app for tracking live poker winnings and losses over time. It focuses on fast entry and clear bankroll visibility without the overhead of a larger gambling analytics platform.
apps.requirements: Web browser on desktop or mobile.
features: Track poker winnings and losses in the browser
Keep a running PnL history for live play
Simple interface built for personal bankroll tracking

apps.name: Munch
apps.subtitle: Can you beat the computer at the game of Munch?
apps.description: Play the classic poison-apple strategy game in your browser and try to avoid the losing move.
apps.longDescription: Munch is a browser game where players take turns eating apples from a grid, and whoever is forced to eat the poison apple loses. This version pits you against a computer opponent built around a solved strategy for the 5x6 board.
apps.requirements: Web browser on desktop or mobile.
features: Play Munch instantly in the browser
Challenge a computer opponent using winning board states
Learn the poison-apple rules through live play

apps.name: Phil's Dictation App
apps.subtitle: Talk to your computer — dictate into any Windows app
apps.description: Respond to emails 10x faster than typing. Write, edit, and paste prose into any Windows app with just your voice. Free trial available.
apps.longDescription: Phil's Dictation App is a native Windows dictation app that lets you respond to emails 10 times faster than typing. Write, edit, and copy prose into any app with just your voice. Voice commands fully control the app: say "wake up" or "resume" to start dictating, "pause" or "go to sleep" to stop, "paste (it over)" to alt-tab to your last app and paste in your text, "undo that" or "select all" to fix mistakes, and "go to beginning (or end)" to move around. Available on the Microsoft Store with a free trial.
features: Talk to your computer and respond to emails 10x faster
Paste your dictation into Microsoft Word or any app with your voice
Voice commands fully control the app — wake up, pause, paste it over, undo that
Free trial available on the Microsoft Store

apps.name: OpenTrackIR
apps.subtitle: Infrared head mouse for macOS & Windows, no proprietary drivers
apps.description: Move your cursor hands-free with NaturalPoint TrackIR hardware — reverse-engineered, cross-platform, no NaturalPoint SDK required.
apps.longDescription: OpenTrackIR is an open-source infrared head mouse that moves your cursor hands-free on macOS and Windows using NaturalPoint TrackIR hardware — built for accessibility. The device protocol is fully reverse-engineered, so it reads the camera cross-platform without the proprietary NaturalPoint drivers or SDK. On Windows, a WinUSB driver installed via Zadig replaces the stock driver; the macOS app streams live camera previews with native Quartz mouse output and a global hotkey (Shift+F7) to toggle mouse movement.
apps.requirements: NaturalPoint TrackIR hardware; Windows 11 (WinUSB driver via Zadig) or macOS.
features: Hands-free cursor movement with infrared head tracking
No proprietary NaturalPoint drivers or SDK — fully reverse-engineered protocol
Live camera preview with centroid and telemetry dashboard
Global hotkey to toggle mouse movement, works from the tray
Cross-platform C core shared by the WinUI Windows app and SwiftUI macOS app

apps.name: Better Swipe Keyboard
apps.subtitle: Android keyboard with good swiping and AI proofreading
apps.description: A personal Android keyboard in Kotlin with swipe typing, voice input, and AI proofreading that stays on-device when it can.
apps.longDescription: Better Swipe Keyboard is an Android keyboard written in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, built to do three things well: swipe typing with a custom decoder tuned against real captured finger trails, voice input via the phone's built-in speech recognizer with an AI cleanup pass, and AI proofreading that fixes the current sentence after you pause — on-device with Gemini Nano when possible, with a zero-data-retention cloud fallback. Plus emoji panel with suggestions, clipboard history, space-bar cursor scrubbing, long-press punctuation, and custom words. Privacy defaults are strict: proofreading stays on-device when it can, clipboard history lives only in memory, and clips flagged as sensitive are never stored.
apps.requirements: Android phone; built with Android SDK 36.
features: Swipe typing with a custom decoder tuned on real finger trails
Voice input with an AI cleanup pass afterwards
AI proofreading on-device with Gemini Nano, zero-data-retention cloud fallback
Emoji suggestions, clipboard history, space-bar cursor scrubbing, custom words
Privacy-first: clipboard in memory only, sensitive clips never stored
